description: Delete an existing link by its path. The operation is irreversible — the shortUrl will stop working immediately. Returns the deleted link record, or a 404 if no link exists at that path. Backed by the Trnqify REST API (DELETE /links/{path}); see the API reference at https://docs.trnqify.com.

path.description: The path identifier of the link to delete

name: deleteLink
title: Delete a link
